remarks: Relax on your front porch and enjoy all the delights of living in the heart of New Canaan. Convenient to town, train, schools, etc. This fully renovated and tastefully designed 4 bedroom home on Main Street is move-in ready. Enter the 2 story foyer with elegant millwork and gleaming custom bleached and whitewashed wood floors throughout. Updated kitchen, bathrooms, doors, roof, HVAC, extensive landscaping, etc., etc.  This beautiful home has a first-floor primary bedroom, eat-in kitchen, dining room, custom designed office/study and a large family room. On the second floor are 3 more bedrooms, brand new bathroom and a home gym. The lower level has high ceilings, natural light and is ready to add up to 850 SF of finished living space. There is a Tesla solar panel system (8.8 KW/22 panels) supplying almost 50% of electricity requirements, plus 2 Tesla Powerwalls providing solar power storage and home power backup source, plus 2 EV charging ports. System installed in August 2022 and conveys free and clear with home. This house has it all and is a great opportunity for the next lucky owner. Don't delay!
